description: This bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)" on the left y-axis and "Token Count" on the right y-axis, displays two metrics for four different methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—represented by distinct colored bars. The horizontal axis lists these four methods, each with a corresponding legend entry below the chart: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The left y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, while the right y-axis, labeled "Token Count", ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. Each bar has its exact value labeled on top. For accuracy, the CoT method achieves 91.19%, CoD achieves 80.89%, CCoT achieves 88.50%, and CoUT achieves 88.40%. For token count, the CoT method uses 676.85 tokens, CoD uses 534.24 tokens, CCoT uses 445.91 tokens, and CoUT uses 354.46 tokens. The bars are arranged in groups of two per method, with the leftmost group showing CoT’s accuracy and token count, followed by CoD’s, then CCoT’s, and finally CoUT’s. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the legend from left to right. The bars themselves are solid colored without any shading or outlining, and no additional visual emphasis is applied beyond the value labels.
